semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Chuan Yao Machinery Co. Ltd provides components and assembly services for semiconductor equipment, which are crucial for manufacturing processes.
summary: Chuan Yao Machinery Co. Ltd specializes in manufacturing components and modules for semiconductor equipment applications. With over 40 years of experience, they offer machining and assembly services for a variety of materials, including metals and plastics, to meet specific design requirements. Their product offerings include chucks for wafers, flow control components, and plumbing fittings, serving industries such as semiconductor equipment and optoelectronic manufacturing.
capabilities: Chucks for wafers and other substrates
Flow control components: valves, meters, gauges, regulators, MFCs
Plumbing fittings: pipes, tubing, hoses, flanges, connectors, couplings
Module assembly services for semiconductor equipment
